titulo.alumno: A look back · What had happened before

intro: Part 3: a look back. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: Use the Danish past perfect «havde/var + participle» to mark an action that happened before another past moment. The auxiliary depends on the verb and the meaning; learn the common uses in context.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Han havde aldrig set havet før den rejse.
frases.alumno: He had never seen the sea before that trip.

frases.estudio: Efter turen forstod han, hvorfor hun savnede øen.
frases.alumno: After the trip he understood why she missed the island.
